emlText.title: Paste one .eml message
emlText.description: Raw RFC 822 text of a single e-mail, headers included. Paste it from Gmail → Show original, Outlook → Save as, or a .eml file.

mboxText.title: Paste an .mbox archive
mboxText.description: Raw mbox text with `From ` separators. Paste it or upload it to the key-value store and use kvStoreKeys instead.

sourceUrls.title: URLs of .eml / .mbox files
sourceUrls.description: Public links to raw mail files. The Actor downloads them into its own container; nothing is sent to a third party.

kvStoreKeys.title: Key-value store keys with mail archives
kvStoreKeys.description: Names of records in the run's default key-value store that contain .eml/.mbox text. Use this for large archives instead of pasting.

maxMessages.title: Max messages per run
maxMessages.description: Free tier is 500 messages. Raise it up to 10,000 for a bigger batch; the paid desktop app indexes archives of any size offline.

includeBody.title: Include a body preview
includeBody.description: Adds a short plain-text preview of the message body to every row. Turn it off if the archive contains sensitive text you do not want in the dataset.

bodyPreviewChars.title: Body preview length (characters)
bodyPreviewChars.description: Used only when includeBody is true.

includeOffer.title: Include the Pro offer record
includeOffer.description: Adds one final record with the offline Archive Studio DocSearch Pro link (TW1-DOC) and the Plati.Market card.
